title: Particular Cases In Drafting
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to state the elements of the offence e.g.: "who assaults", "contravenes subsection (1)", "commits an offence", "is liable", rather than incorporating "shall"."
The present tense is used to state the elements of the offence e.g.: "who assaults", "contravenes subsection (1)", "commits an offence", "is liable", rather than incorporating "shall".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a standard feature of all or of particular kinds of legislative instruments in your jurisdiction."
Note down whether section notes are a standard feature of all or of particular kinds of legislative instruments in your jurisdiction.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the principal mechanism used to prevent or control anti-social behaviour and unacceptable activities."
The criminal law is the principal mechanism used to prevent or control anti-social behaviour and unacceptable activities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first drafting task given to most Legislative Counsel."
Drafting subsidiary legislation is the first drafting task given to most Legislative Counsel.
fib: ______ is the one between several countries.
A multilateral treaty is the one between several countries.
______ are used here solely to create vicarious liability.
The highlighted words are used here solely to create vicarious liability.
______ is a vital part of treaty negotiation process.
Preparation is a vital part of treaty negotiation process.
______ are a title, authorising words, definitions, formal sectioning and section notes and explanatory notes.
Typical exclusions are a title, authorising words, definitions, formal sectioning and section notes and explanatory notes.
